text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer camp. I
show Sakura Chiyono O my
notes on our
agenda and what I want her to focus on.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay... I guess that's summer camp
for you—we have a ton to
get through!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I trust you and your
Trainynotes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Problems I need to work on,
techniques I can use to
improve—they're
all written here in this notebook.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing you read those books you
bought and put a lot of
thought into
coming up with this regimen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Which means, all your care and hard work
as a trainer is packed in
here—it's your
Trainynotes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just watch—I'll use our time at camp to
improve as much as I can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes light up, burning bright with
determination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! ...Almost to shore!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Can't stop yet! Ten more sets! "The Chiyo
that walks about finds the
starting gate"!

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't you think Chiyo seems almost
like a different person since
coming here?

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's like super into it. We have to
train harder too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... That should be everything for today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like everyone was staring at me on
the way here... Was I doing
something
weird?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Guess there's nothing to worry about
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our days of endless training continue, and
before we know it, camp
draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: 0.1 seconds... Our 0.1 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's not much... almost nothing really, but
still! I'm that much closer to
Maruzen now,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our summer camp comes to an end. And
now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there was a festival going on
so close by. Thanks for
bringing me here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Then I'll be sure to make the most
of it! Cotton candy, yo-yo
fishing, goldfish
scooping, and... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This plush doggie, doesn't it kinda remind
you of Maruzen? Like how
fluffy it is, and
those kind eyes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's so cute! Hey there, little guy, you
wanna come home with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: M-me?! You mean...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, n-n-no! Never mind! Ahaha. Oh,
Trainer, you're funny, you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
You two take a liking to that stuffed
animal? Then why don't ya have
a go at
our katanuki challenge?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Katanuki?

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here's how it works: you take this sheet of
candy here, and using a
needle and your
fingers, cut out the shape in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Make a clean cut, and I'll give ya the
doggie as a prize! How about it?
Up for a
try?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I do really like the doggie, but... this
looks kind of hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All fired up to win Chiyono O her prize, I
give the katanuki challenge
a go, only to
find it more difficult than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oof, close but no cigar. How about
another go?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, um, Trainer? Maybe you should start
out away from the indents!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Looking at your previous tries, slowly
chipping away at the perimeter
seemed
like the safest option, so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-what? No, I was just jotting down notes
as I watched... A-anyway,
you've got this!

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! We have a winner! And to the victor
goes the stuffed animal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you're sure I can have it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'll name you Sakura Dogg-O.
Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you're the only one who thinks that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Whether it looks like me or not
aside, um... thank you once
again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Not just for this little guy, but for all of
summer camp, and everything
before that
too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Remember what you told me once? That
watching me gives you
strength, and
seeing me work hard gives you courage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. When I see you
working hard, it makes me want
to do my
best too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've found more strength than I ever did
alone. I've come so much
farther than I
ever could alone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I know that as long as we keep working
hard together, I can get
even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your source of strength, and you'll
be mine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And then, even winning the Derby won't
just be some faroff
dream—we'll be strong
enough to do it for real!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Or, um... th-that's what this little fella
thinks, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm going to make my dreams come
true! Even if I can't grow as
quick as
everyone else, no matter how long it
takes, I swear I will!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The late-blooming sakura is still a
sakura," am I right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if in agreement, fireworks bloom bright
in the night sky.
